title: On-call Rotations Snaplet with Audit Linklets
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Proposal: a compact, contextual "snaplet" that surfaces on-call rotation details inline on alert threads and incident summaries, plus small audit linklets for fast access to postmortems, SLO slices, and audit logs. Goal is to reduce cognitive overhead during triage by keeping essential rotation info and audit links one tap/click away without switching context to the full People/On-call page. The snaplet should be timezone-aware, show next handoff window, allow fast 'transfer baton' flow, and embed read-only links to the latest postmortem and related SLO snapshots.
acceptance_criteria: Snaplet appears on alert and incident summary rails for users with sufficient permission
Displays current on-call assignee, timezone, and next handoff timestamp (localized)
Includes two primary linklets: latest postmortem (if exists) and last 24h SLO slice for the impacted service
Transfer baton control launches existing handoff modal (reuses current auth/flow)
All states covered: no-rotation, single-responder, multi-rotation, and unknown/disabled
Design passes an accessibility check (contrast, keyboard nav, screen reader labels)
design_notes: Keep visual weight minimal: 64px height compact card with an affordance to expand to 220px for additional quick actions
Primary CTA order: Transfer > Message assignee > View postmortem. Secondary: open SLO snapshot
Use tokenized linklets (chip pattern) rather than full link text to preserve vertical rhythm
Microcopy should surface recency for postmortems (e.g., 'PM: 2025-10-30, 18h ago')
When rotation is empty, show 'No rotation configured' + link to configure (permission gated)

2025-12-02 - Design review: rounded corners and chip sizes adjusted after accessibility pass. Preparing Handoff spec and interaction prototype for dev handoff
